chars.MOURAD: MOURAD: a 29-year-old Moroccan man, short black hair, light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers.
chars.SAFAE: SAFAE: a 32-year-old Moroccan woman wearing a burgundy hijab and a long beige cardigan over a navy dress.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a 55-year-old Moroccan mother wearing a green-and-white floral djellaba and a white headscarf.
chars.RACHID: RACHID: a stocky 45-year-old Moroccan man with a thin mustache, wearing a red-and-white checkered short-sleeve shirt and brown trousers.
chars.HOUDA: HOUDA: a 30-year-old Moroccan woman with long wavy black hair, wearing a tight purple dress and a black leather jacket.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Casablanca family living room, SAFAE bursts in crying with tears on her cheeks, gesturing angrily, while MOTHER grabs her arms with a shocked, worried face. Dramatic emotional tension between them, 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a narrow hallway of a modest Casablanca apartment, MOURAD stands outside a closed wooden bedroom door, leaning his ear toward it, curious and worried, light leaking under the door.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MOURAD sits on a Moroccan salon sofa with patterned cushions, shrugging with open palms and a relaxed 'it's normal' expression, a glass of mint tea on a small round table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MOURAD frowns suspiciously with narrowed eyes in the foreground; behind him, as a faded thought-bubble-like vision, RACHID smirks slyly. Moody evening light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the front door of a newly built unfinished concrete house on the outskirts of Casablanca at dusk, RACHID looks left and right nervously while sneaking HOUDA inside by the hand, HOUDA giggling. Sneaky, comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, MOTHER whispers urgently to SAFAE who is sitting on a stool wiping her tears, both close together, secretive mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the same small Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, MOTHER holds a finger to her lips with a stern warning look while SAFAE nods sadly. Secret being kept.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOURAD bursts through the kitchen doorway with an angry shocked face, while MOTHER and SAFAE, standing by the blue zellige counter, turn toward him startled with wide eyes. Freeze-frame dramatic moment.
